Public Portion 
 1. Appropriation Order for Taking for the German Gerena School Projects 
$645,000 (Mayor Sarno) 
 2. Order of Taking of Land for the New German Gerena School 
 
Minutes: 
On July 27, 2026, the Maintenance and Development Committee, chaired by Councilor Lavar 
Click-Bruce, reviewed a $645,000 appropriation and an order to acquire three properties needed 
for construction of the new Gerena School. The properties include two vacant lots and one four-
family property. Officials explained that the acquisition is a friendly eminent domain taking 
funded through PAYGO and that relocation expenses will be presented separately because 
acquisition and relocation costs are not eligible for 80 percent reimbursement. 
 
The proposed school is approximately 138,000 square feet and will include 13 preschool 
classrooms, three classrooms per grade, and approximately 170 parking spaces. Officials are 
developing a traffic plan and expect the relocation of four families to take approximately four to 
eight months with assistance from a relocation specialist. The order was orally amended to 
reflect updated property ownership and recording information. The committee approved moving 
the appropriation and amended land-taking order to the full City Council. 
The meeting adjourned at 5:16 p.m.
